title: Realizing actual system projection identities at integral coefficients
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{k_0}$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $t$; put $A_n=R/(t^n)$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], not a datum assuming projection invertibility. Schemes are finite type over $k$ and their structure morphisms need not be separated. Use the small pro-etale coefficient categories and the specified compactification projection map [def-exchange-projection], with compact-support functors [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be separated finite-type morphisms, and use integral inputs $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$, $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,R)$ in [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. On each small pro-etale site let $\mathscr S_W$ be the category of strict semilinear systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves, $\mathcal R_W$ derived reduction and $\mathcal L_W=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ total limit [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Use the actual simultaneous system pullbacks, tensor, proper images, open extensions and their maps of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization], with $c_V:\mathcal L_WV(\mathcal RK,\mathcal RL)\cong V_{\rm int}(K,L)$ its canonical realization for an expression $V$. Every intermediate normalized system in the projection, refinement and compact-support composition expressions has compatible etale-origin witnesses and bounded constructible cohomology and Tor intervals independent of $n$, so these $c_V$ apply. For every generating map $m$ in those expressions, with source expression $S$ and target $T$, one has
$$c_T\,\mathcal L(m)=m_{\rm int}\,c_S.$$
Consequently the actual system projection composition, proper/open, refinement and identity equations give the corresponding equations for the specified integral PF maps after conjugation by $c_S,c_T$, including nested compact-support operations and the associativity pentagon. The direct-image/limit comparison is the canonical one for $R,(t)$, whose quotients have two-term finite-free resolutions. These are equalities of realized maps; faithfulness of finite evaluation is not assumed.

proof.text: The coefficient uniformizer generates the nonzero maximal ideal by [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], hence it is nonzero. The coefficient integers form a subring of the field E, so multiplication by any power is injective. Membership in the quotient kernel is membership in the principal power ideal, equivalently divisibility by that power; the quotient map is surjective. These are exactly the three assertions in the two-term resolution clause. The normalized direct-image/limit comparison is already a field of the realization datum and needs no additional comparison theorem.
